kinds.title: Apps
kinds.blurb: Full product screens: mail, chat, calls, notes, drive, help.

screens.title: Mail
screens.blurb: A three-pane mail client you can run from the keyboard: J and K walk the threads, E archives with an undo, R drops you into a quick reply, and the reading pane slides over the list on phones.

screens.title: Team Chat
screens.blurb: Channels and DMs with grouped messages, reactions that roll their counts, and threads that open in a side panel; send something and a teammate starts typing back.

screens.title: Video Call
screens.blurb: A video call where the grid reflows as people drop in and out, whoever is talking gets a soft ring and a pulse, reactions float up the stage, and chat and people slide in beside it.

screens.title: Notes
screens.blurb: A notes app with folders, pinned notes that glide to the top, search that highlights matches as you type, and an editor where typing “[] ”, “- ” or “# ” turns a line into a checklist, bullet or heading.

screens.title: Drive
screens.blurb: A cloud drive home with a sidebar of places and quick access, start-from-template cards, and folders that glide between a card grid and a tidy table when you switch views, with search, sort and stars.

screens.title: Folder View
screens.blurb: One folder opened inside a drive, with a folder tree in the sidebar, type filters with counts, a grid of file cards with little drawn previews or a dense table, a bulk bar that rises with a rolling count when you pick a few, and ghost files fanning out of an empty sub-folder.

screens.title: Help Centre
screens.blurb: A support site with a search that suggests articles as you type, topic cards, readable articles with a table of contents that follows you, and a feedback form that asks what went wrong.

kinds.title: AI & Agents
kinds.blurb: Assistant home, agent runs, prompt evals, co-writing.

screens.title: Assistant Start
screens.blurb: The first screen of an AI assistant, with chats and projects down the side, a gooey orb that says hello and a prompt box that gathers tools and connected apps as context, then glides down into the conversation when you send.

screens.title: Conductor
screens.blurb: Chat with a lead agent while it works: it streams its replies, hands tasks to helpers whose progress ticks along in a side panel and writes what it learns straight into a launch brief you can edit beside the chat.

screens.title: Run Replay
screens.blurb: Watch an agent work a task from start to finish: plan steps tick off, tool calls stream into a log, it stops to ask before sending anything, and the draft it's writing fills in beside it.

screens.title: Prompt Test Bench
screens.blurb: Check a prompt before it ships, with pass rate by version against the bar it has to clear, a unified or side-by-side diff of what changed, and test cases that re-run live from queued to a rolling score.

screens.title: Co-writing Doc
screens.blurb: A document where AI agents write alongside you: coloured cursors with name tags glide between words, an agent types its suggestion letter by letter for you to accept or reject, and comments sit in the margin next to the lines they're about.

kinds.title: Dev tools
kinds.blurb: Code review, docs sites, keyboard-driven issue tracking.

screens.title: Code Review
screens.blurb: A pull request review with a file tree, split or unified diffs with word-level highlights, inline threads you can reply to and resolve, Viewed checkboxes that fold files away, and an approve or request-changes panel.

screens.title: Docs Site
screens.blurb: A documentation site with a top nav, collapsible sidebar, code samples whose language choice follows you across the page, a table of contents that tracks your scroll, ⌘K search over pages and headings, and prev and next cards.

screens.title: Keyboard issue tracker
screens.blurb: An issue list you drive with your hands on the keys: J and K to move, S, P, A and L to change status, priority, assignee and labels, X to multi-select, ⌘K for everything else, and rows glide to their new group when they change.

kinds.title: Personal

screens.title: Money
screens.blurb: A personal finance home: the balance rolls digit by digit as you switch accounts or pay a bill, the payment lands in your transactions, spending donut and budgets at once, and each budget shows if you’re spending ahead of pace.

screens.title: Habits
screens.blurb: A habit tracker that makes ticking things off feel good: checks fill and draw in a beat, counted habits fill like a glass, streaks roll up, and a week grid lets you patch the days you forgot to log.

screens.title: Music Player
screens.blurb: A music app with gradient cover art that glows into the room, a waveform you can scrub, a drag-to-reorder queue and lyrics that follow the song line by line.

kinds.blurb: Checkout and live order tracking.

screens.title: Checkout
screens.blurb: A one-page checkout that folds each finished step into a one-line summary: inline validation that clears as you type, delivery choices that re-total the order, a card that flips when you reach the CVC, and a calm confirmation.

screens.title: Delivery Tracker
screens.blurb: Live order tracking on a hand-drawn city map: the courier rides the route as the ETA counts down, you can zoom in to follow them, message with quick replies, and rate and tip once it lands.
